name: Farming
summary: Plots that take a seed, grow over game days, ripen sooner for each watering, and yield the crop's authored harvest.

parameters.doc: days a crop with no growth row takes

extensionPoints.doc: the crop a planting pane picked; none stated = core's chooseCrop (the plot's refusals, then the first sowable crop in id order, else nothing-to-sow); a parameter-level hook, not Prolog facts

assistant.summary: Farming is core's farming module (src/production/farming.ts) remembered by ProductionDirector; the day comes from the time pack (ProductionDirector.setDay).
notes: With no crop stated, core chooses: after the plot's own refusals, the first crop of the book in id order whose seed, tool and skill the actor has, else nothing-to-sow (PL.core-craft-chooser, docs/native-production.md section 3.6).
doNot: Pick the crop at harvest: a plot yields what was planted.
